About us
Alliance University is the first private university in South
India, established in Karnataka under Act No. 34 of
2010, and recognized by the University Grants
Commission (UGC), New Delhi. The University was
awarded an A+ grade by NAAC in 2024, reflecting its
commitment to academic excellence.
At Alliance University, research is the cornerstone of
teaching and learning, fostering a strong synergy
between knowledge creation and application. The
University aims to tackle real-world challenges at local,
national, and global levels by acting as a hub for
collaboration among industry, government, civil
society, and the community.
In an era of rapid technological and social
transformation, Alliance University embraces diverse
disciplines and specializations while promoting the
integration of knowledge to prepare students for the
evolving demands of employability and global
leadership.

Over the years, Alliance ONE has been anchored in the spirit of the United Nations Sustainable
Development Goals (SDGs). Our commitment to equity, inclusion, sustainability, innovation, and
community well-being is not symbolic—it is intentional and consistent.
The 2026 edition marks an important inflection point. Guided by the
theme Equity. Empowerment. Excellence., it places a focused lens on
the role of women in leadership, creativity, innovation, and societal
transformation. This year also invites students to engage deeply with the
realities of Bengaluru-a city shaped by aspiration, complexity, and
constant reinvention.
In essence, Alliance ONE is not merely a
celebration-it is a platform for purpose. My
appreciation to the students, faculty mentors, and
partners who have shaped this edition.
Mr. Abhay G. Chebbi
Pro-Chancellor
Alliance University
